maya: :mega: Heads-up — security baseline scanner requirement for Private (VPC/on-prem) starts 2026-05-01. Internal runbook: https://go.redwood/private-baseline-scan
josh_security: TL;DR bullets so teams can copy into customer notes:
josh_security: • New local config scanner (non-blocking at first) checks kernel settings, firewall rules, TLS ciphers, KMS attestation presence, and agent version.
josh_security: • Customers must run scan within 30 days of onboarding. Reports can be kept local or uploaded with consent.
josh_security: • We will flag high-risk findings (e.g., public etcd, disabled mTLS) that require remediation for SLA customers.
legal_phi: Legal note — scan outputs are configuration metadata only. No customer data is collected unless customer opts into upload. For gov/regulatory accounts we will follow approved deviation flows; route exceptions to legal@redwood.com.
ops-bot: Action created: task/PRIVATE-SCAN-3932109999 assigned to support_lead (due 2026-05-31).
docs: Customer-facing runbook + FAQ will be published tomorrow. We'll include an annotated remediation checklist and recommended OS packages.
docs: CLI example for customers (local, no upload):
docs: ```
redwoodctl private scan --target local --format json --upload false --timeout 10m
```
docs: To consent to uploads (for assisted remediation):
docs: ```
redwoodctl private scan --target local --format json --upload true --consent "support-remediation"
```
maya: Important: uploading is opt-in. If uploaded, we only capture config hashes, package versions, and explicit debug artifacts agreed in the consent string.
support_lead: Support offering — we will provide a "Scan & Remediate" addon SKU for customers who want us to run scans and deliver a prioritized remediation plan. Sales ops: add SKU to quoting templates.
josh_security: Enforcement cadence: May 1 -> advisory, Jun 1 -> reminders and targeted outreach, Jul 1 -> required for new SLA enrollments (customers without a completed scan may be limited to security-only SLA until remediated).
devrel: Can we get a one-liner for customers to put in their onboarding emails? Something like: "Run the Redwood Private Baseline Scanner to verify your environment meets our secure deployment checklist — opt-in upload available for assisted remediation."
maya: Yes, that's perfect. I'll drop it in the onboarding templates.
maya: Next steps: 1) docs publishes runbook (tomorrow). 2) Support + sales add SKU (this week). 3) Legal prepares deviation form and answers (EOD). 4) Outreach to current Private customers this week with migration guidance.
josh_security: Ping me if you want the scanner rulebook (sig-based) — will share observability criteria for ops teams.
maya: Thanks everyone :pray:
